name: Share Watch (example)
description: Example plugin (opt-in) for plugin authors: shows how to receive public-share-link hooks. It adds no UI — each link created or revoked is written as one line (share code and fragment-free URL, never the key) to this plugin's log (Plugins → Share Watch → Logs).
author: cognia-next

zh-CN.manifest.name: 分享监听（示例）
zh-CN.manifest.description: 面向插件作者的示例插件（需手动开启）：演示如何接收公开分享链接钩子。它不添加界面——每个链接的创建或撤销都会以一行记录（分享码和不含片段的网址，绝不含密钥）写入本插件日志（插件 → 分享监听 → 日志）。
